en.t: This refers here to the Hitachi Assistant Governor.

units.source_text: 常陆的国守是由亲王担任的，臣下不能当国守。

en.t: The governor of Hitachi was a post held by an imperial prince, so a subject could not serve as governor.

units.source_text: 但实际政务由介掌管，故称介为守。

en.t: But because the assistant governor actually managed the affairs of government, he was called the governor.
